item.title: RTT: Selection procedures for the recruitment of 3 RTT at the University of Salento (Univ. del SALENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. del SALENTO, Lecce
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-06 Fisica per le scienze della vita, l'ambiente e i beni culturali, didattica e storia della fisica

Selection procedures to fill three tenure-track fixed-term researcher (RTT) positions pursuant to Art. 24, paragraph 3, of Law no. 240 of 30 December 2010, reserved for holders of fixed-term researcher contracts—as referred to in Art. 24, paragraph 3, letter a) of the same Law (in the version in force prior to the entry into force of Law no. 79 of 29 June 2022; known as RTDA)—expiring in 2025 or 2026: SSD CHEM-06/A; SSD PHYS-06/A; SSD MATH-06/A.
